mapper.select: SELECT menu_id AS "menuId", upr_menu_id AS "parentId", menu_nm AS name, scrn_id AS "screenId", icon_nm AS icon, (mbl_expsr_yn = 'Y') AS mobile FROM sys.menu WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_seq, menu_id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cmn.cd_grp WHERE cd_grp_id = #{group})
SELECT dtl_cd AS code, cd_nm AS name, attr1_val AS attr1, attr2_val AS attr2, attr3_val AS attr3 FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id = #{group} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_seq, dtl_cd
SELECT cls_ym AS month, cls_stts_cd AS status FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_ym >= #{from} AND cls_ym <= #{to} ORDER BY cls_ym

SELECT oprt_std_id AS key, aply_bgn_ym AS "effectiveMonth", oprt_std_nm AS name, num_val AS "numberValue", txt_val AS "textValue", unit_nm AS unit, use_plc_desc AS usage FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id = #{key} AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
